verdict.rationale: Runpod documents per-second billing for all compute and storage, Pods included. For Serverless it explicitly states billing runs only from when a worker starts until it fully stops, and Flex workers scale to zero when idle. However, the evidence never says that Pod (instance) compute charges stop when a Pod is stopped, and storage is also billed per second, so 'only while running' is shown only for Serverless. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Pod/instance charges stop when the Pod is stopped (and how stopped-Pod storage is billed), independent or hands-on corroboration of billing granularity.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running

citations.quote: Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, with no fees for data ingress or egress.
All compute and storage charges are billed per second, with no fees for data transfer.
You're billed from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second.
Flex workers | Scale to zero when idle | Standard per-second rate
